stages.name: intake
stages.detail: bundled proxy.js, port.js, mover.mjs match canonical

stages.name: serve
stages.detail: cd "$DATA/host" && exec php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=$PORT → http://127.0.0.1:34007

checks.name: Page loads through proxy
checks.detail: HTTP 200, landed on /mixpost, title "Dashboard - Mixpost - Laravel"

checks.name: port.js runs in the live page
Mover attached into Port drawer slot
checks.detail: section[data-capability=button-mover] data-trust=trusted, in drawer=true, mover UI=true

checks.name: App controls found for the mover
Drag-move a link
checks.detail: <a> "" (display:inline): mover recorded translate="120px 60px" (saved=true); on screen it moved 0,0px — NOT moved visually: CSS translate has no effect on display:inline elements

checks.name: Drag-move a button
checks.detail: <div> "Unlock Pro Features" (display:block): mover recorded translate="120px -60px" (saved=true); on screen it moved 120,-60px, visible and clickable at the new spot

checks.name: Move survives reload
checks.detail: mover re-attached from storage; moved controls after reload: 2 (120px 60px, 120px -60px)

checks.name: Reset restores positions and labels
checks.detail: moved left=0, renamed left=0, saved positions=0, label restored=true

checks.name: No new uncaught errors with the Port
checks.detail: none (0 uncaught error(s) seen, all also raised by the app without the Port)

checks.name: App CSP lets the Port run
Redirects and links stay on the proxy
checks.detail: 15 link/form/asset URL(s) in the page point at <upstream>

checks.name: Customer skins through the proxy
checks.detail: acme→midnight: applied; globex→sunrise: applied; initech→blueprint: applied; no header → original look

checks.name: Sticky-notes capability on the live page
checks.detail: pinned=true ("Pinned by ATTa×", visible=true), after reload=true, clear=true

steps: Capability Port (injected before </head>) — attach the button mover
button-mover attached in the drawer slot
Move: on — every button and link is now draggable
sticky-notes capability attached — pin a note
note pinned on the live app and dragged into place
customer "acme" → skin "midnight" (moves, names and notes kept)
customer "globex" → skin "sunrise" (moves, names and notes kept)
customer "initech" → skin "blueprint" (moves, names and notes kept)
Reset + Clear — app back exactly as it was
